root_cause.text: In the `mtype_del` function of the ipset hash implementation, a bucket is only freed when both `n->pos` (number of allocated entries) and `k` (count of unused slots below `n->pos`) are zero, but this misses the case where all live entries have been deleted yet `n->pos` points beyond deleted slots, leaving the bucket as a logical empty (wasted memory and potential misuse).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "mtype_del() counts empty slots below n->pos in k, but it only drops the bucket when both n->pos and k are zero. This misses buckets whose live entries have all been removed while n->pos still points past deleted slots." The patch changes the condition from `if (n->pos == 0 && k == 0)` to `if (k == n->pos)`, which correctly treats a bucket as empty when all positions below `n->pos` are unused.
